wardrobe_list_user.sql: SELECT id, name, category, created_at FROM clothing WHERE user_id = :uid ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100
scan_types: Bitmap Index Scan on  using idx_clothing_user

wardrobe_filter_category.sql: SELECT id, name, category, created_at FROM clothing WHERE user_id = :uid AND category = 'Tops' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100
scan_types: Bitmap Index Scan on  using idx_clothing_user

post_feed_global.sql: SELECT id, user_id, caption, created_at FROM posts WHERE caption NOT LIKE '[MOMENT:%' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 30

post_list_by_user.sql: SELECT id, user_id, caption, created_at FROM posts WHERE user_id = :uid AND caption NOT LIKE '[MOMENT:%' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 30

moments_user_active.sql: SELECT id, user_id, caption, created_at FROM posts WHERE user_id = :uid AND caption LIKE '[MOMENT:24H:%' AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' ORDER BY created_at DESC

moments_discovery_feed.sql:
SELECT id, user_id, caption, created_at 
                FROM posts 
                WHERE caption LIKE '[MOMENT:24H:%' 
                  AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
                  AND user_id IN (SELECT following_id FROM follows WHERE follower_id = :uid)
                ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 30

followers_count.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM follows WHERE following_id = :uid

following_list.sql: SELECT following_id FROM follows WHERE follower_id = :uid

comments_by_post.sql: SELECT id, user_id, content, created_at FROM comments WHERE post_id = :pid ORDER BY created_at ASC

likes_count_by_post.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM likes WHERE post_id = :pid

notifications_list_user.sql: SELECT id, type, title, is_read, created_at FROM notifications WHERE user_id = :uid ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50

notifications_unread_count.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM notifications WHERE user_id = :uid AND is_read = false

recommendations_active_occasion.sql:
SELECT id, outfit_id, occasion, recommendation_score, created_at 
                FROM recommendations 
                WHERE user_id = :uid AND occasion = 'Casual Daily' AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
                ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
scan_types: Index Scan on recommendations using idx_recommendations_created

recommendations_history.sql: SELECT id, outfit_id, occasion, created_at FROM recommendations WHERE user_id = :uid ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 30
scan_types: Index Scan on recommendations using idx_recommendations_user

wear_history_recent.sql: SELECT id, outfit_id, worn_at FROM wear_history WHERE user_id = :uid AND worn_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days' ORDER BY worn_at DESC
scan_types: Index Scan on wear_history using idx_wear_history_user

collections_user_list.sql: SELECT id, name, created_at FROM collections WHERE user_id = :uid ORDER BY created_at DESC

outfit_clothing_by_garment.sql: SELECT outfit_id FROM outfit_clothing WHERE clothing_id = :cid

user_login_email_ilike.sql: SELECT id, username, email FROM users WHERE lower(email) = 'test@example.com' LIMIT 1

user_profile_username_ilike.sql: SELECT id, username, first_name, last_name FROM users WHERE lower(username) = 'test' LIMIT 1

user_search_pattern.sql: SELECT id, username, first_name, last_name FROM users WHERE is_active = true AND (lower(username) LIKE '%alex%' OR lower(first_name) LIKE '%alex%') LIMIT 20
